We propose UniConv, a unified neural network architecture for end-to-end dialogue systems... integrates BDST with a Joint Dialogue Act and Response Generator (DARG) that simultaneously models dialogue acts and generates system responses.

UniConv integrates BDST with a Joint Dialogue Act and Response Generator (DARG) that simultaneously models dialogue acts and generates system responses by learning a latent variable representing dialogue acts and semantically conditioning output response tokens on this latent variable.
outputs: System responses in natural language sequences
